svg.title: ArchFlow responsive knowledge crew architecture
svg.desc: Seven labeled layers connect reviewed source and memory contracts on the left to accountable individual and team outputs on the right. Each connection states what it contributes and what remains gated.
svg.text: One responsive knowledge crew — seven accountable layers
Source records preserve identity; roles own work; typed state controls progress; requirements and reviewers control advancement.

text.tspan: Never stores credentials or raw traces.
Not implemented in the public core;
Always followed by exact file reads.
team state adds tenancy and recovery.

g.text: Goal · role · permission · risk · reviewer · done and stop conditions
Reviewed source manifest · authority · owner · freshness · allowlist
Controlled context · lexical retrieval · source paths · exact reads · gaps
Functional role contracts · smallest responsible team · bounded handoffs
Onboarding · requirements · outreach · copy · design · code · reporting
Typed states · attempt caps · interrupts · validation · review · readback
Exact result · reusable learning · promotion candidate · lineage · freshness

text.tspan: Guard: scope is admitted before work.

svg.text: No-provider public default · no autonomous writeback · exact authority approval remains target-specific
Portable core: exact-manifest retrieval + deterministic contracts. Private source data never enters the public repository.
